Reproduced this on a real server (PostgreSQL 16, Node 26, `max: 1`, `cancel_timeout: 0.5`, `pg_sleep(10)` ahead of a `sql.batch`, then `cancel()`). On master the batch and `cancel()` are both still pending after 3 s. With this branch `cancel()` resolves and the batch rejects with `CONNECTION_DESTROYED`, same as a plain `cancel()` that hits `cancel_timeout`. The new unit test also fails against master's `src` and passes here.

I used Claude to run the checks.
